<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="greenBg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cardPurple" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#A06AF9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FBA3FF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#200E32" flood-opacity=".10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F7F8F5"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="36" fill="#F7F8F5"/>
  <text x="22" y="22" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">9:41</text>
  <line x1="327" y1="21" x2="327" y2="15" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="332" y1="21" x2="332" y2="12" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="21" x2="337" y2="9" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="16" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="348" y1="16" x2="351" y2="19" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="360" y="11" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="362" y="13" width="16" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#200E32"/>
  <rect x="383" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#200E32"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="29,61 22,68 29,75" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="45" y="74" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#200E32">Checkout</text>
    <circle cx="360" cy="68" r="16" fill="#E9F5E5"/>
    <line x1="354" y1="62" x2="366" y2="74" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="366" y1="62" x2="354" y2="74" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Product summary -->
  <text x="20" y="108" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Order summary</text>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="119" width="350" height="84" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="32" y="131" width="61" height="60" rx="12" fill="#DFF1D9"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="143" r="7" fill="#FFDD72"/>
  <polygon points="39,181 54,158 65,170 74,161 88,181" fill="#97DAA4"/>
  <rect x="102" y="135" width="190" height="18" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="103" y="148" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#200E32">Oak writing desk</text>
  <text x="103" y="172" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Natural oak · 1 item</text>
  <text x="103" y="190" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">Sold by Maya Thompson</text>
  <text x="338" y="151" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">$189.00</text>

  <!-- Payment heading -->
  <text x="20" y="237" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Payment method</text>
  <text x="370" y="237" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Secure checkout</text>

  <!-- Saved card one -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="249" width="350" height="66" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="34" y="263" width="42" height="29" rx="5" fill="url(#cardPurple)"/>
  <rect x="38" y="268" width="34" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".45"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="283" r="4" fill="#FFDD72"/>
  <text x="89" y="273" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Visa ending in 4242</text>
  <text x="89" y="294" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Expires 08/27</text>
  <circle cx="344" cy="282" r="10" fill="#97DAA4"/>
  <polyline points="339,282 343,286 350,278" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Saved card two -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="323" width="350" height="66" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="34" y="337" width="42" height="29" rx="5" fill="#200E32"/>
  <rect x="38" y="342" width="34" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".35"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="357" r="4" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
  <text x="89" y="347" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Mastercard ending in 9018</text>
  <text x="89" y="368" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Expires 11/26</text>
  <circle cx="344" cy="356" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Add payment button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="398" width="350" height="48" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="422" r="10" fill="#E9F5E5"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="422" x2="53" y2="422" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="417" x2="48" y2="427" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="68" y="427" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Add payment method</text>
    <polyline points="346,418 350,422 346,426" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Cost breakdown -->
  <text x="20" y="482" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Price details</text>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="494" width="350" height="142" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <text x="38" y="523" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Item price</text>
  <text x="350" y="523" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#200E32">$189.00</text>
  <text x="38" y="555" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Shipping fee</text>
  <text x="350" y="555" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#200E32">$12.50</text>
  <text x="38" y="581" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#828282">Arrives by Jun 18–20</text>
  <line x1="38" y1="597" x2="352" y2="597" stroke="#E7E7E7" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="38" y="622" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Total</text>
  <text x="350" y="622" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#200E32">$201.50</text>

  <!-- Confirmation note -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="661" r="8" fill="#E9F5E5"/>
  <polyline points="24,661 27,664 32,658" fill="none" stroke="#6EA95C" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="43" y="665" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Your payment information is encrypted and secure.</text>

  <!-- Buy now -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="684" width="350" height="52" rx="16" fill="url(#greenBg)"/>
    <text x="195" y="717" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Buy now · $201.50</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Navigation bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="758" width="390" height="86" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="758" x2="390" y2="758" stroke="#E7E7E7" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,781 49,773 59,781 59,792 52,792 52,785 46,785 46,792 39,792" fill="#200E32"/>
    <text x="49" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#200E32">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="111" y="774" width="17" height="17" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="115" y1="779" x2="124" y2="779" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="115" y1="784" x2="124" y2="784" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="119" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Projects</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="782" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="190,782 194,786 201,778" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Tasks</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="263" y="774" width="20" height="15" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="267,789 270,793 273,789" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="273" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Chat</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="341" cy="779" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="341" cy="790" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="341" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="154" y="831" width="82" height="4" rx="2" fill="#200E32"/>
</svg>
